page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor. The instance provides 64 vCPUs derived from 32 dedicated physical cores clocked at 2.55 GHz, using two threads per core. Memory capacity totals 128.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 compute-optimized memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Cache configuration includes 32 KB L1 data cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. The x86_64 architecture supports hardware cryptographic extensions including AES, VAES, and SHA-NI, alongside AVX, BMI2, and FMA, though AVX-512 extensions are absent. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, while local instance storage is not included and must be provided via network-attached storage.

Benchmark evaluations indicate competitive multi-core computational throughput and fast cryptographic capability. The instance demonstrated strong performance in PassMark CPU testing (59,199.92), PassMark encryption tests (68,060.68), and stress-ng multi-core testing (86,349.63). Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression achieved 275.48 GB/sec, placing it within the top quartile. Geekbench scores registered 1,532.0 for single-core and 14,302.0 for multi-core compute. In memory throughput, small block cached read tests reached 4,132.73 GB/sec, whereas uncached large-block tests registered an average 85.04 GB/sec read and 38.03 GB/sec write. In artificial intelligence inference workloads, the instance processed small 135M parameter models efficiently, reaching 2,865.39 prompt tokens per second, but settled into mid-tier performance for 7B models (10.01 tokens per second generation).

Given its compute-heavy resource ratio and strong multi-core scalability, the instance delivers solid resource density for CPU-bound tasks without the overhead of excess memory. However, the lack of local NVMe storage requires architectural reliance on external disks, which should be factored into high-IOPS storage designs. Best-fit workloads for ecs.c7a.16xlarge include multi-threaded batch data processing, distributed compilation, cryptographic microservices, video rendering, and compute-bound application serving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by a 2.55 GHz AMD EPYC 7T83 processor. Operating on KVM, it provides 64 vCPUs across 32 physical cores with hyperthreading, paired with 128.0 GB of RAM to maintain a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The instance features no local storage and includes a 16 Gbps baseline network interface. Hardware security and calculation extensions include AES, VAES, SHA-NI, and AVX. In benchmark tests, the instance shows top-tier throughput in multi-core metrics, scoring 59,199.92 in PassMark CPU, 68,060.68 in encryption, and 86,349.63 in multi-core stress-ng tests. Large-block memory bandwidth and general Geekbench results align with mid-tier levels. The configuration suits computational batch workloads, CI/CD compilation, encryption services, and data transformation tasks.
